lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs arranged in four primary horizontal rows along the mid-to-posterior flank, transitioning to a higher-density, less linear distribution in the anterior region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form a grid; circular blobs are positioned at the nodes of this grid, particularly prominent between the first and second dorsal fins.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the flank; the medial ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular blobs are distributed across the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with higher spatial frequency observed toward the base and anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A yellow cylindrical electronic tracking tag is attached via a tether to the flank, situated slightly ventral and posterior to the leading edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Several commensal fish (likely remoras) are attached to the ventral surface of the shark and the trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
